Create a variety of charts—bar charts, line charts, pie charts, radar charts, Sankey diagrams, bubble charts, heatmaps, and more—along with dynamic data syncing, real-time updates, and high-quality exports.

Key Features

• Versatile Chart Creation: Design a wide range of charts including bar charts, line charts, pie charts, radar charts, Sankey diagrams, bubble charts, heatmaps, tree maps, calendars, funnel charts, box plots, 3D charts, and many more. Regular updates bring new chart types to meet evolving needs.
• High-Quality Export: Export charts in high resolution for print, reports, and presentations.
• Dynamic Data Updates: Automatically sync charts with live data from CSV, Excel, ensuring your visualizations stay accurate and up-to-date.
• Interactive Elements: Add tooltips, drilldowns, and clickable features for a more engaging and interactive experience.
• Advanced Customization: Customize every aspect of your charts—colors, labels, fonts, layouts—to match your branding or personal preferences.
• Cross-Platform Sync: Seamlessly sync across iPhone, iPad, Mac, and VisionPro, ensuring a consistent workflow across devices.

Perfect For

• Business Intelligence: Visualize KPIs, track financial performance, and create insightful reports to drive data-driven decisions.
• Academic Research: Present research data and statistical findings with clear, professional charts.
• Professional Reports: Design eye-catching visuals for annual reports, business proposals, and presentations.
• Marketing Campaigns: Create stunning visuals for advertising, social media, and product launches.
• Educational Materials: Craft engaging charts for lessons, classroom presentations, and projects.
• Nonprofit Organizations: Communicate your organization’s impact through visualized data for fundraising, donor contributions, and campaign results.
• Financial Analysis: Visualize investment portfolios, market trends, and financial reports for budgeting and decision-making.
• Event Planning: Organize schedules, guest lists, and resource management with clear, easy-to-read charts.

Supported Chart Types

• Bar Charts: Basic bar charts, waterfall charts, negative bar charts, and more.
• Line Charts: Basic line charts, smoothed lines, stacked lines, gradient areas, and more.
• Pie Charts: Simple pie charts, rounded corner pies, and rose charts.
• Radar Charts: Basic radar charts, circular radar charts, and more.
• Sankey Charts: Flow charts and flow diagrams.
